name: infinite-canvas
description: 面向 AI 创作的开源无限画布工作台，集成 AI 生图、参考图编辑、视频生成、Agent 智能助手、画布编排、对话创作、提示词库与素材管理等能力，支持可视化创作流程与多 Agent 协同工作。兼容 OpenAI 接口生态，支持 chatgpt2api、grok2api、flow2api、newapi 等渠道接入。

latest_release.name: v0.20.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* fix(canvas): keep overlay UI at a constant on-screen size while zooming by @peanut2001 in https://github.com/basketikun/infinite-canvas/pull/251
* fix: prevent unavailable model selections from silently falling back by @blackdm666 in https://github.com/basketikun/infinite-canvas/pull/252
* fix(canvas): pin select-references hint to the viewport top center by @Booome in https://github.com/basketikun/infinite-canvas/pull/256
* fix(canvas): hide node hover toolbar while selecting references by @Booome in https://github.com/basketikun/infinite-canvas/pull/257
* fix(canvas): compact create menus and localize node titles by @Booome in https://github.com/basketikun/infinite-canvas/pull/258
* fix(canvas): copy inbound reference connections when duplicating nodes by @Booome in https://github.com/basketikun/infinite-canvas/pull/259
* feat(canvas): add regenerate-in-place preference for nodes with content by @Booome in https://github.com/basketikun/infinite-canvas/pull/260
* fix(canvas): keep focused node and its overlays inside the viewport by @Booome in https://github.com/basketikun/infinite-canvas/pull/262
* feat(canvas): thumbnail view and hover preview for the element list by @Booome in https://github.com/basketikun/infinite-canvas/pull/263
* feat(canvas): add center-focus toolbar button and auto-center on select preference by @Booome in https://github.com/basketikun/infinite-canvas/pull/264
* fix(video): attach images field and ratio for NewAPI and Seedance compatibility by @vecyang1 in https://github.com/basketikun/infinite-canvas/pull/265
* fix: handle missing storage estimate API by @BlackSmithM in https://github.com/basketikun/infinite-canvas/pull/284

## New Contributors
* @blackdm666 made their first contribution in https://github.com/basketikun/infinite-canvas/pull/252
* @vecyang1 made their first contribution in https://github.com/basketikun/infinite-canvas/pull/265
* @BlackSmithM made their first contribution in https://github.com/basketikun/infinite-canvas/pull/284

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/basketikun/infinite-canvas/compare/v0.19.0...v0.20.0
